text:
I need to have the soul tame

like a sad mastered beast,

to please it with barbs, the smoothness

of its skin dazzled in meekness.


It is necessary to tame it, so that its fever

not tremble in my blood for even a minute.

Let the fires of the thickest

oil of horror flood it, and let it resist.


Oh, my soft and subjected soul,

sweet beast enclosing itself in my body!

Lightning, screams, chill, and even people

urging it to come out. And it, dark.


I ask you, love, to allow me

to finish off my imprisoned tiger.

To give you (and free myself from this fury)

a still, unfading fragrance.

translation.title: Dominion
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the soul as tamed beast and imprisoned tiger turned toward fragrance.
